text: Tarfin, Fenerbahce basketball's name and chest sponsor, describes itself as a technology platform that began operating in 2017 offering forward-purchase (vadeli) trading in agriculture; its Tarfin Flex subsidiary is wholly owned by Tarfin Tarım A.Ş. The club announcement names its board - chairman Ali Emre Ballı and vice chairman Yiğit Gözübüyük - private individuals, with no state or fund ownership mentioned by the company or the club.
short: Tarfin is a private Turkish agritech platform founded in 2017.

source.name: BasketFaul - Fenerbahce, yeni sponsoru Tarfin'i acikladi (Tarfin press release)
source.quote: 2017 yılında tarım sektöründe vadeli alışveriş imkânı sunan bir teknoloji platformu olarak faaliyetlerine başlayan Tarfin
